## What will it actually run?

A 2,048Wh battery typically delivers around 1,650–1,850Wh through its AC outlets after conversion losses, depending on the load.

| RV equipment | Estimated runtime |
|---|---|
| 50W average load | 33–37 hours |
| 100W average load | 16–18 hours |
| 500W coffee maker or appliance | 3.3–3.7 hours |
| 1,000W appliance | 1.6–1.8 hours |

These are illustrative calculations, not measured runtime tests. Refrigerators cycle on and off, so their actual runtime depends on daily energy consumption.

For boondocking, the AC200L should be useful for lights, a water pump, electronics, and an efficient refrigerator. It is **not a practical solution for running rooftop air conditioning overnight** without substantially more battery capacity.
